Class WaveTextState

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.wavetext.WaveTextState
public final class WaveTextState extends Object
State for the WaveText widget, tracking animation progress.

The tick value controls where the bright peak appears in the wave effect. Call tick() each frame to advance the animation. 

WaveTextState state = new WaveTextState();

// In your render loop:
state.tick();  // Advance animation
frame.renderStatefulWidget(waveText, area, state);
